QuestInfo.name: [Esfera] Her Barrier
QuestInfo.0: The Executor guiding you says you cannot continue because of Tana's barrier. Listen to the details.
QuestInfo.1: You need to enhance the power of the Executor by defeating Keepers, which are fragments of power. Defeat around 200 #bKeepers of Darkness#k and talk to Ollie.
QuestInfo.2: The Executor who had its power enhanced left first again. Follow the Executor.
